# Mem0 — Project Memory Config

Mem0 adds self-improving memory to AI agents.

## Setup

1. Create an account at https://mem0.ai
2. Generate an API key
3. Configure your agent to use Mem0 MCP or SDK

## Environment

```
MEM0_API_KEY=your_key_here
```

## MCP endpoint

```
https://mcp.mem0.ai/mcp
```

Docs: https://docs.mem0.ai/platform/mem0-mcp
